newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Sudjana says Busang talks continue.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Sudjana says Busang talks continue.

text.p: Indonesia's Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana said on Wednesday Bre-X Minerals Ltd and Barrick Cold Corp were still negotiating with their Indonesian partners ahead of a mid-February deadline on the Busang gold find.
"I think the deadline is February 17. I don't know where they are negotiating and what is their agreement. I don't want to interfere," Sudjana said.
"Up till know, there has been no report on their meetings to me," he added.

He said President Suharto would decide on the Busang property, estimated by Bre-X to hold at least 57 million ounces of gold, if the two Canadian companies failed to reach agreements with their local partners.
"The president will decide on the matter," he said before a cabinet meeting.

David Walsh, Bre-X chairman and chief executive officer, said on Monday the firm was making progress in talks with its local partners over the Busang gold find in Indonesia's East Kalimantan province.

Walsh said the Indonesian government had given Bre-X and Barrick until February 14 to reach agreements with their respective local partners before it gave the go-ahead for further exploration and development of Busang.
A Bre-X source said Walsh had left on Wednesday for Canada.
